gameplay.tagline: Every bullet in flight slows you down.
gameplay.rule_current: A current pushes you to the left. The left edge is the void: it destroys the ship.
gameplay.rule_drag: The more bullets you have in flight, the slower you are. A bullet that hits vanishes and frees you.
gameplay.rule_purge: Purging erases all your bullets in flight and gives your speed back at once.
gameplay.controls: Move: {move} or arrows   ·   Fire: Space (hold)   ·   Purge: Shift   ·   Pause: Esc
gameplay.stats: Time {time}   ·   Sector {sector}   ·   Enemies destroyed {kills}   ·   Accuracy {accuracy}%   ·   Best chain ×{chain}
gameplay.restart: SPACE: play again   ·   ESC: title screen

feedback.too_slow: TOO SLOW: STOP FIRING OR PURGE
feedback.twist_tip: Your bullets in flight slow you down. Aim well, stop firing or purge with Shift.
